Container.Name: binventory
Container.Overview: Storage bin inventory. Track what's in each bin (items, photos, rack/shelf location) from your phone and print 4x6 labels with QR codes that open the bin's contents. Optional local AI (Ollama) describes and tags bins from their photos.

Config.Name: BASE_URL
Config.Description: URL phones use to reach this app, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8080. Encoded into every QR code.

Config.Name: AUTH_USER
Config.Description: Login username. Required for remote access (without a login only LAN/Tailscale devices can connect).

Config.Name: AUTH_PASS
Config.Description: Login password. Use a long one if this is reachable from the internet.

Config.Name: OLLAMA_URL
Config.Description: Optional local AI: Ollama address, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:11434. Photos are analyzed to fill in the description and search tags. Blank = off.

Config.Name: OLLAMA_MODEL
Config.Description: Ollama vision model (run: ollama pull gemma3:4b)

Config.Name: SESSION_DAYS
Config.Description: Days a device stays signed in
